channel.title: daryo
channel.description: Regional headlines in English, updated four times a day.

item.title: Uzbek President Attends Opening Ceremony of World Nomad Games in Bishkek
item.description: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev participated in the opening ceremony of the sixth World Nomad Games in Bishkek. Over 3,000 athletes from more than 90 countries are competing. Uzbekistan has 141 representatives participating in 30 sports, including kurash, sambo, and equestrian events.

item.title: Foreign Leaders Congratulate Uzbekistan on Independence Day
item.description: Foreign leaders are sending congratulatory messages to Uzbekistan's President Shavkat Mirziyoyev on the country's 35th Independence Day. Messages highlight Uzbekistan's reforms, socio-economic development, and its role in Central Asian peace and regional cooperation. Partnerships in trade, investment, and culture are noted.

item.title: Uzbek and Russian Presidents Meet in Bishkek to Discuss Strategic Partnership
item.description: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev met with Russian President Vladimir Putin in Bishkek. The leaders discussed further developing strategic partnership and allied relations between Uzbekistan and Russia. The meeting took place during the World Nomad Games.

item.title: Uzbek President Meets US Special Envoy Sergio Gor in Bishkek
item.description: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev met with US Special Envoy for South and Central Asia Sergio Gor in Bishkek. They discussed strengthening Uzbek-American strategic partnership, political dialogue, and economic cooperation. Priorities include energy, transport, critical minerals, digital technologies, and agriculture.

item.title: Indian companies may invest $3.4 billion in Uzbekistan's energy sector
item.description: Indian companies are considering investing $3.4 billion in Uzbekistan's energy sector. The Energy Minister stated that five major projects have been proposed to investors, including the construction of high-voltage power lines, hydroelectric, and thermal power plants.

item.title: Kazakhstan's Kurultai to focus on AI, migration, and energy policy
item.description: Kazakhstan's Kurultai will address artificial intelligence, migration policy, and energy sustainability. Deputies will review existing laws, develop AI and digital assets, and regulate online platforms. The Kurultai will also discuss the national budget for the next three years.

item.title: Uzbek President Discusses Cooperation With UN Secretary-General
item.description: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev met with UN Secretary-General António Guterres on the sidelines of the SCO summit in Bishkek. Guterres congratulated Uzbekistan on its 35th independence anniversary. They discussed expanding cooperation with the UN and its institutions, and Guterres welcomed Uzbekistan's achievements in Sustainable Development Goals.

item.title: Kazakhstan's 'Umai' mortgage program for women temporarily suspended due to fund exhaustion
item.description: Kazakhstan's 'Umai' mortgage program, exclusively for women, has suspended new applications after exhausting its current funding tranche. Launched on August 31, the program reached its limit the same day. Otbasy Bank is exploring early disbursement of the next tranche, planned with the Asian Development Bank, to resume applications.

item.title: Uzbek President and Chinese President Discuss Strengthening Comprehensive Cooperation
item.description: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev met with Chinese President Xi Jinping in Bishkek during the SCO summit. Mirziyoyev thanked Xi for congratulations on Uzbekistan's independence anniversary and contributions to bilateral relations. They proposed a program to celebrate the 35th anniversary of diplomatic ties next year and noted trade turnover nearing $18 billion.

item.title: Kyrgyz President Japarov announces Russia's readiness to host 2028 World Nomad Games in Tatarstan
item.description: Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov announced at the VI World Nomad Games opening ceremony that Russia has officially offered to host the VII World Nomad Games in Tatarstan in 2028. Japarov thanked Russian President Vladimir Putin and pledged Kyrgyzstan's support for the event.

item.title: Sadyr Japarov announces Russia's readiness to host the 2028 World Nomad Games in Tatarstan
item.description: Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov announced at the VI World Nomad Games opening ceremony that Russia has officially offered to host the VII World Nomad Games in Tatarstan in 2028. Japarov thanked Russian President Vladimir Putin and pledged Kyrgyzstan's support for the event.

item.title: Kyrgyzstan President: Tatarstan ready to host next World Nomad Games in 2028
item.description: Kyrgyzstan President Sadyr Japarov announced that Russia, specifically Tatarstan, has officially offered to host the 7th World Nomad Games in 2028. He expressed gratitude to Vladimir Putin and pledged Kyrgyzstan's full support for the event.

item.title: Uzbekistan President Mirziyoyev meets China's Xi Jinping in Bishkek, discusses trade
item.description: During the SCO summit in Bishkek, Uzbekistan President Shavkat Mirziyoyev held talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping. They discussed strengthening bilateral relations, aiming to increase trade turnover to $30 billion, and cooperation in industry and agriculture.

item.title: Indian PM Modi Urges Putin to End War at SCO Summit
item.description: During the SCO summit in Bishkek, Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi told Russian President Vladimir Putin that India supports peace talks and diplomatic efforts. Modi stated that the war is setting humanity back and India's message is to end the conflict, not prolong it.

item.title: Kyrgyzstan President Launches VI World Nomad Games in Bishkek
item.description: Kyrgyzstan President Sadyr Japarov officially opened the VI World Nomad Games in Bishkek on August 31. The ceremony was attended by leaders from Azerbaijan, Iran, Kazakhstan, Laos, Mongolia, Russia, Tajikistan, Turkey, and Uzbekistan, along with other international dignitaries. The games celebrate nomadic civilization.

item.title: Singapore's Senior Minister Lee Hsien Loong Addresses Senate in Tashkent
item.description: Singapore's Senior Minister Lee Hsien Loong delivered a speech at the Senate of Uzbekistan. Discussions focused on elevating Uzbekistan-Singapore relations, expanding parliamentary cooperation, and exchanging experiences in public administration, education, human capital, and innovation.

item.title: Uzbek President Arrives in Bishkek for SCO Summit and 'SCO Plus' Meeting
item.description: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev has arrived in Bishkek to attend the Shanghai Cooperation Organization (SCO) Council of Heads of State meeting and an 'SCO Plus' format meeting. He was welcomed at Manas International Airport by Kyrgyz officials and is scheduled for bilateral meetings and the opening ceremony of the World Nomad Games.

item.title: Uzbek President Mirziyoyev Meets Pakistan's Prime Minister to Boost Cooperation
item.description: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev met with Pakistan's Prime Minister, agreeing to strengthen cooperation in textiles, medicine, pharmaceuticals, and agriculture. The discussions focused on enhancing bilateral ties across various sectors.

item.title: Russia Extends Temporary Ban on Diesel and Gasoil Exports Until September 30
item.description: The Russian government has extended its temporary ban on the export of diesel and gasoil until September 30 to stabilize the domestic fuel market. This measure applies to direct producers. Meanwhile, drivers report fuel shortages on the M-11 highway, with long waits for gasoline.

item.title: VI World Nomad Games Opening Ceremony Held in Bishkek with International Dignitaries
item.description: The VI World Nomad Games commenced with an opening ceremony at Bishkek Arena, featuring the parade of athletes from 112 countries. Dignitaries including Prime Ministers and UN Secretary-General Guterres attended. Over 29,000 spectators were present.

item.title: VI World Nomad Games Open in Bishkek with Record Participation
item.description: The VI World Nomad Games commenced with an opening ceremony at Bishkek Arena, featuring a parade of athletes from 112 countries, a record number of participants. Dignitaries including the UN Secretary-General and leaders from various nations attended. The main sports program runs September 1-6 in Issyk-Kul.

item.title: Fergana Region's Economy Shows Growth: GDP Up 9.1%, Investment Reaches 25.7 Trillion Sums
item.description: Fergana Region's Gross Regional Product (GRP) reached 65.2 trillion sums in January-June 2026, a 9.1% increase year-on-year. The region's share in Uzbekistan's GDP rose to 6.1%. Services dominate the GRP at 49.2%, followed by agriculture (27.3%), industry (15.7%), and construction (7.8%). Investments in the region's economy and social sphere totaled 25.7 trillion sums.

item.title: Tajikistan to Pilot Electronic Wallet Taxation System from September 1
item.description: Tajikistan's National Bank will pilot an electronic wallet taxation system for three months starting September 1. The system aims to digitize tax accounting for individual entrepreneurs. The final launch date will be determined after the trial period.

item.title: Kazakhstan to Increase Social Payments and Minimum Wage in 2027
item.description: Kazakhstan plans to adjust social payments and calculation indicators starting January 1, 2027, according to a draft law on the republican budget for 2027-2029. The monthly calculation index is set at 4,693 tenge, the living wage at 55,173 tenge, and the minimum pension at 74,919 tenge.

item.title: Xi Jinping Misses World Nomad Games Opening Due to China Disaster
item.description: Chinese President Xi Jinping was unable to attend the World Nomad Games opening ceremony in Bishkek due to a natural disaster in China's Tibet Autonomous Region. The Kyrgyz President's press secretary stated that Xi Jinping requested understanding for his absence, prioritizing disaster relief efforts. Bilateral meetings during his state visit will continue as planned.

item.title: Xi Jinping Missed World Nomad Games Opening Due to Tibet Disaster
item.description: Chinese President Xi Jinping could not attend the 6th World Nomad Games opening ceremony in Bishkek due to a natural disaster in China's Tibet Autonomous Region. The Kyrgyz President's press secretary stated Xi prioritized disaster relief efforts and search operations in his country.

item.title: World Nomad Games Opening Ceremony Begins at Bishkek Arena
item.description: The official opening ceremony of the VI World Nomad Games has commenced at the Bishkek Arena, featuring the raising of Kyrgyzstan's flag and the national anthem. A parade of athletes from 112 participating countries, a record number, followed. Dignitaries including the Prime Ministers of Armenia, India, and Pakistan, along with the UN Secretary-General, are in attendance.

item.title: High-speed train tested on Tashkent-Andijan route, reaching 160 km/h
item.description: A high-speed train was tested on the Tashkent-Andijan route, traveling at speeds of 160 km/h. The new train is expected to begin serving passengers in the coming days. Further details are available via the provided link.

item.title: World Nomad Games Opening Ceremony Sees Arrival of International Leaders in Bishkek
item.description: President Sadyr Japarov welcomed international guests, including leaders from Belarus, Vietnam, and Togo, along with the UN Secretary-General, at the VI World Nomad Games opening ceremony in Bishkek. The event drew approximately 29,000 spectators.

item.title: Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov Congratulates Alexander Lukashenko on Double Birthday
item.description: Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov congratulated Belarusian leader Alexander Lukashenko and his son Nikolai on their birthdays during the opening ceremony of the VI World Nomad Games in Bishkek. Lukashenko and his son arrived for the event, where Japarov welcomed them.

item.title: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev Meets with Donald Trump's Special Envoy Sergio Gor in Bishkek
item.description: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev met with Donald Trump's special envoy Sergio Gor in Bishkek. The discussions focused on further strengthening Uzbekistan-US strategic partnership relations. The meeting took place during the World Nomad Games.

item.title: World Nomad Games Opening Ceremony in Bishkek Attracts International Leaders
item.description: Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov welcomed international leaders, including Belarus's Alexander Lukashenko and UN Secretary-General António Guterres, at the opening of the VI World Nomad Games in Bishkek. The event, held at Bishkek Arena, drew approximately 29,000 spectators.

item.title: Press center established for World Nomad Games opening ceremony, over 1200 media attend
item.description: A special press center has been set up to cover the VI World Nomad Games opening ceremony, with over 1,200 media representatives from approximately 100 countries attending. The head of the presidential administration's information policy service stated that all necessary conditions are provided for journalists.

item.title: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev visits Kyrgyzstan for SCO summit and related meetings
item.description: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev traveled to Bishkek on August 31 for the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO) Council of Heads of State meeting and an 'SCO plus' format encounter. Discussions will focus on SCO development and regional cooperation, including bilateral meetings and the opening ceremony of the World Nomad Games.

item.title: Uzbekistan to Expand Cooperation with UN; President Mirziyoyev Meets António Guterres in Bishkek
item.description: Uzbekistan plans to expand its cooperation with the United Nations. President Shavkat Mirziyoyev met with UN Secretary-General António Guterres in Bishkek to exchange views on pressing issues. The meeting took place during the SCO summit.

item.title: Uzbekistan and China leaders discuss boosting trade to $30 billion
item.description: During a meeting in Kyrgyzstan, the leaders of Uzbekistan and China discussed various issues, including a proposal to increase bilateral trade volume from the current $18 billion to $30 billion. The leaders engaged in discussions on multiple aspects of their bilateral relationship.

item.title: Uzbek President Proposes New System for Preserving Memory of Victims of Repression
item.description: Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev proposed developing a new system to preserve the memory of victims of political repression and those who died for the country. He noted the expansion of efforts to immortalize victims' memories, including publishing books and holding events.

item.title: Ukraine may strike Russia using Starlink, Zelensky asked Musk for permission
item.description: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky reportedly asked Elon Musk for permission to use Starlink-equipped drones against Russian targets up to 200 kilometers inside Russian territory. The Financial Times reported this, citing sources familiar with the matter.

item.title: Tajikistan's National Bank to Pilot E-Wallet Taxation from September 1
item.description: Tajikistan's National Bank announced a three-month pilot program for taxing individual entrepreneurs via e-wallets, starting September 1. The system aims to tax business transactions through e-wallets, with a previously proposed rate of 3% (down from 6%). Further details on specific transaction limits are pending. The bank is collaborating with innovation agencies and tax authorities.

item.title: Uzbekistan Showcases Crafts at Venice's Homo Faber Exhibition
item.description: Uzbekistan is participating in the fourth edition of the Homo Faber 2026: An Island of Light exhibition in Venice, showcasing contemporary artistic craftsmanship. Organized by the Michelangelo Foundation, the event features over 700 artworks from 500 artisans worldwide. Uzbekistan's participation is supported by the Foundation for Development of Culture and Arts, which began collaborating with Michelangelo Foundation in 2022.
